truth_label_semantics: In the controlled critic micro-experiment, truth means RK45 local rewards and successor states plus one common frozen bootstrap value. It is not full-mission Q truth or an oracle long-term action ranking.
limits: All DEV models are technical only. Report seen-state withheld-action errors and unseen-state errors separately. Prediction error, coverage and nonzero gradients do not establish final policy gain; matched real training is required.
